summary: The main article describes a transition-metal-free photoredox-catalyzed cross-coupling of 4-alkyl-dihydropyridines with vinylbenziodoxolones to synthesize functionalized alkenes and C-vinyl glycosides. The document includes optimization tables, scope schemes for various alkyl and glycosyl precursors, and mechanistic studies supporting a concerted radical coupling pathway.
